details: Bitcoin (BTC) saw a significant price surge, climbing over 15% in two days to exceed $77,000 and briefly touch $81,000. This rally was triggered by the U.S. Treasury's unexpected expansion of its bond repurchase program. The move also led to over $300 million in liquidations for short sellers who were caught off guard by the upward momentum.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $77K on Treasury Bond Buyback Expansion

details: Ethereum (ETH) has demonstrated strong consolidation above the $2,400 mark, suggesting a potential 30% price rally. It has been a leading performer among major cryptocurrencies recently, driven by sustained institutional interest and significant inflows into U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs. BlackRock's ETHA fund has notably led these inflows, contributing to over $1.5 billion in net inflows across 12 trading days.
title: Ethereum Eyes 30% Rally Amidst Strong ETF Inflows

details: Major financial services firm Charles Schwab has expanded its crypto trading offerings to include Solana (SOL), Avalanche (AVAX), and Chainlink (LINK). This move broadens their digital asset exposure beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum, signaling increasing mainstream acceptance. Concurrently, Solana validators approved a proposal to double the network's disinflation rate, a measure expected to reduce future SOL supply by approximately 20 million tokens over six years.
title: Charles Schwab Adds Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink to Trading Platform

details: Bitcoin experienced a pullback, trading below $78,000, influenced by a substantial $6.36 billion in BTC options expiring. This was compounded by hawkish remarks from Fed Governor Kevin Warsh at Jackson Hole, who hinted at potential rate hikes. Historically, such signals tend to suppress demand for non-yielding assets like Bitcoin. However, strong institutional ETF inflows and deeper market liquidity helped mitigate a more severe decline.
title: Bitcoin Volatility Amidst Options Expiry and Hawkish Fed Comments

details: XRP reached $1.68 on August 22nd but has since retreated to $1.38. Despite an overall 30% gain in August, it is currently encountering resistance in the $1.40 to $1.50 range. Key catalysts that could propel XRP towards its all-time high include a September 15th CLARITY Act cloture vote and continued inflows into XRP ETFs, which have seen nearly $127.34 million in August.
title: XRP Faces Resistance, Eyes CLARITY Act Vote and ETF Inflows for Rally
